name: Camino a la Escuela
source:
You arrive at a high school in Spain and you don't know the language. You will have to learn Spanish, and your friends will help you!

[From [url=https://khan-art-studio.itch.io/camino-a-la-escuela]itch.io[/url]]

你到达西班牙的一所高中，但你不懂该语言。你必须学习西班牙语，你的朋友会帮助你！
